description: On the desk there’s a white paper cup with water and brushes, a watercolor palette to the right, a napkin with paint marks in the middle, and a painted sheet at the bottom right. The left hand stays low near the center of the desk, while the right hand lifts a paintbrush, moves it down into the cup to rinse, then pulls it out and wipes or dabs the brush tip on the napkin before moving away.
